title: Barbers: Prosecution should seek 16 votes despite 14-vote threshold

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors should still prefer to get 16 votes to convict Vice President Sara Duterte even though the Senate impeachment court had already adopted a lower threshold that will allow a verdict with 14 votes. Former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House impeachment adviser and trial spokesperson, explained in a statement that getting 16 votes to convict would insulate the prosecution from another legal dispute on how the constitutional two-thirds requirement should be computed. “If they ask me, I’ll say let’s look for 16 [votes] to prevent any challenge before the Supreme Court,” Barbers said in a statement issued […]...
